name: VNC Unblocker
postStartCommand:
echo '#!/bin/bash
xrdb $HOME/.Xresources
xsetroot -solid grey
export XKL_XMODMAP_DISABLE=1
startxfce4 &' > ~/.vnc/xstartup && chmod +x ~/.vnc/xstartup && rm -rf /tmp/.X1-lock /tmp/.X11-unix/X1 && vncserver :1 -geometry 1280x800 -depth 24 -localhost no && websockify --web /usr/share/novnc/ 6080 localhost:5901 &
